activities.name: Shanghai Museum East Campus (Pudong · permanent galleries)
activities.schedule: Wed–Mon 10:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00); closed Tuesday except national holidays.
activities.cost: ¥0 general permanent-gallery walk-in entry with valid passport/ID; special exhibitions separate
activities.exception: Primary recommended museum campus for Feb–Mar 2027 while People's Square permanent galleries are closed (A04). Open Mondays (closed Tuesdays).

activities.name: Shanghai Museum — People’s Square (special exhibition only)
activities.schedule: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 (last entry 15:00 under current exhibition notice); closed Monday except national holidays.
activities.exception: PARTIAL CLOSURE NOTICE (A04): Official notice states Jul 9, 2026 – Nov 14, 2027 only a paid special exhibition is open at People's Square (advance reservation required; exact exhibition fee not stated on general visitor page). Closed Mon Feb 15 & Feb 22.

activities.name: Yu Garden — daytime classical garden (not bazaar)
activities.schedule: Tue–Sun 09:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00); closed Monday except national holidays.
activities.exception: Monday closure includes Feb 15 & Feb 22 under regular rules. Separate from free Yuyuan Bazaar streets and paid Lantern Festival / night-tour events (Feb 20, 2027 is Lantern Festival).

activities.name: Yu Garden — seasonal night tour
activities.schedule: Published seasonal notice: Fri–Sun 18:00–21:20 (last entry 20:30); closed Mon–Thu except public holidays.
activities.cost: ¥300–¥436 = 2 × ¥150–¥218 published seasonal notice (2027 Lantern Festival surcharges unconfirmed)
activities.exception: Published municipal seasonal notice, not a confirmed Feb–Mar 2027 ticket schedule; recheck before booking.

activities.name: The Bund waterfront promenade & Bund Ferry
activities.schedule: Promenade open 24h; architectural illumination 17:00–21:00 (Nov–Apr winter schedule per Shanghai Gov).
activities.cost: ¥0 promenade walk (optional Jinling East Rd – Dongchang Rd Bund Ferry: ¥4 = 2 × ¥2 one-way, 10 min)
activities.exception: Arrive before 17:00–21:00 illumination cutoff in Feb–Mar; crowd controls may apply on holiday evenings.

activities.name: Shanghai Tower — Top of Shanghai Observatory (118F · 546m)
activities.schedule: 08:30–22:00 (municipal observatory schedule; official site lists hotline 09:00–18:00 — reconfirm last entry).
activities.cost: ¥360 = 2 × ¥180 standard 118F adult ticket (per Shanghai Municipal Gov notice)
activities.exception: Visibility-dependent high-altitude deck; check cloud ceiling and 126F damper add-on availability before purchasing.

activities.name: Shanghai Disneyland
activities.schedule: Date-specific park hours published on official resort calendar (typically 08:30–20:30/21:30).
activities.cost: From ¥950 = 2 × ¥475 standard 1-Day Ticket (2-Day Early Bird from ¥1,508 = 2 × ¥754; 1-Day + Premier Access from ¥1,740 = 2 × ¥870)
activities.exception: Date-tiered pricing rises on weekends/holidays; buy via official Disney app/site only with passport numbers. Metro Line 11 terminus (~45–65 min from central Puxi; verify hotel-specific transit).

activities.name: Power Station of Art (上海当代艺术博物馆)
activities.schedule: Tue–Sun 11:00–19:00 (last entry 18:00); closed Monday except national holidays.
activities.exception: Closed Mon Feb 15 & Feb 22 under regular rules; check exhibition changeover dates around late Feb 2027 (current Liu Jiakun show runs to Feb 21, 2027).

activities.name: The Palace Museum (Forbidden City)
activities.schedule: Nov 1 – Mar 31: Tue–Sun 08:30–16:30 (last entry 15:30); closed Mondays except statutory holidays.
activities.cost: ¥80 = 2 × ¥40 off-season general entry (Treasure & Clock Galleries ¥10/person each extra)
activities.exception: Real-name passport booking opens 7 days out at 20:00 Beijing time on intl.dpm.org.cn; closed Mon Feb 15 & Mon Feb 22 under regular rules.

activities.name: Temple of Heaven
activities.schedule: Park & inner monuments have separate winter hours; inner monuments closed Monday.
activities.exception: Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, Echo Wall & Circular Mound closed Mondays; buy full through-ticket rather than park-only gate ticket.

activities.name: Summer Palace (颐和园)
activities.schedule: Nov–Mar winter hours; inner courtyard sites close Mondays (confirm exact gate cutoff before visit).
activities.cost: ¥40 = 2 × ¥20 off-season gate entry; ¥100 = 2 × ¥50 off-season combination ticket
activities.exception: Kunming Lake boats suspended during winter ice period; Subway Line 4 Beigongmen Station access.

activities.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
